source_interpretation: Only same-period one-equal-mass-atom-per-cell products with the stated envelope and parameter sequence, and their fixed measurable positive probability mixtures. General C_n and the full scale axis are not covered.
actual_runs: conditional_probe.py (45 comparisons, within-bin moment checks, count-IS)
multinomial_probe.py (3 fixed configurations + 1 preselected diagnostic; NumPy2.3.5)

historical_snapshot.purpose: Necessary evidence for the original v16 mass/branch anomaly, the pre-harmonization normalizer difference, and the initial NUMERICS tables. Not a second claimed asymptotic result.

root_changes_after_agent_run: Recorded raw-mean normalizer exponent in the coefficient-integrand bound and re-inverted all heldout Chernoff bounds during the fresh run.
Recorded maximum contributions in the compact fixed-threshold tables.
Updated filenames, archive relative references and run-status metadata.
limitations: Double-precision conditional moments/variance/likelihoods lack interval certification.
Different NumPy multinomial algorithms consume different random sequences; initial and final environments have different numerical realizations.
Nine target lengths imply a deterministic weak coefficient cap of 9; these tests cannot establish asymptotic log gains.
The highest-v tail ESS is too low for trend claims.
